headline: Laxmi Goldorna House submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Laxmi Goldorna
summary: Laxmi Goldorna House Limited has submitted its annual general meeting scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchange. The meeting was held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine post-AGM compliance filing required for listed entities. Retail investors have no financial or operational impact from this standard regulatory submission.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no financial impact
